title: Exam Orientation and How to Study

header.html: exam format and weights; performance-based questions; how the 27 objectives map to this course (supports every objective)
the official CompTIA Security+ SY0-801 V8 exam objectives, document version 2.0

html:
1What the exam is

CompTIA Security+ V8 (SY0-801) tests the knowledge of a security administrator with about two years of hands-on experience. You must identify, interpret and support incident response, assess security posture and recommend solutions, manage modern environments (cloud, mobile, hybrid), work with governance, risk and compliance, and apply mitigations for threats and vulnerabilities.

Fact Value
Exam code SY0-801 (version 8)
Questions Maximum of 90: multiple choice and performance-based
Time 90 minutes
Passing score 750 on a scale of 100 to 900
Launch and old version V8 launches on or around November 17, 2026; V7 (SY0-701) retires in 2027 [Verify live]
Price, retake rules [Verify live] not on the pages this course was built from: confirm on the CompTIA site
Note

. The scale is 100 to 900, so 750 is not 75%. Do not compute a percentage; aim to understand every objective.

2The five domains

Domain Weight What it asks
1.0 General Security Concepts 16% Controls, change management, cryptography
2.0 Threats, Vulnerabilities, and Attacks 24% Actors, vectors, vulnerability types, indicators, AI risks
3.0 Security Architecture 19% Architecture models, infrastructure, data protection, resilience
4.0 Security Operations 27% Hardening, monitoring, identity, automation, incident response
5.0 Security Program Management and Oversight 14% Governance, risk, third parties, compliance, audits, awareness

Security Operations is the biggest, followed by Threats, Vulnerabilities, and Attacks. Every domain counts: a weak domain can cost you the pass.

Exam tip

. V8 expands coverage of AI-related risks, security operations and modern environments. Expect AI threats (prompt injection, poisoning, hallucinations) and AI-assisted automation in questions.

3Question types

Type What it looks like How to handle it
Multiple choice A scenario and four or more options; single answer or choose two or three Read the last sentence first, then the scenario
Performance-based (PBQ) A simulation: match items, drag and drop, order steps, configure a rule, read a log Skip and return: they take longer; do the quick questions first

PBQs usually appear early in the exam. Flag them, answer the multiple-choice questions, then come back with the time left. Partial credit may be given on some PBQs, so never leave one empty. [Verify live]

4How the objectives are worded

Verb What you must be able to do
Explain / Describe Say what it is, why it matters and how it works
Compare and contrast Tell options apart and choose between them
Given a scenario Read a situation and pick or apply the right control, step or tool
Summarize Know the main points and terms
Analyze Interpret evidence, such as logs or indicators

"Given a scenario" objectives are the practical ones. Learn each concept with a use case and a trade-off.

5A repeatable way to answer

  1. Read the last sentence first: what is asked (best, first, most likely, next)?
  2. Underline the key facts: the asset, the threat, the constraint (cost, time, legal).
  3. Remove options that do not fit the category (a detective control in a "prevent" question).
  4. Compare what is left against the key words best, first and most.
  5. Mark and move on if you are unsure after a minute.
Exam tip

. Words that change the answer: BEST (most appropriate), FIRST (earliest step; often "contain" or "verify"), MOST likely, LEAST privilege, NOT. Read them twice.

6A study plan

Step What to do Modules
1 Foundations: controls, change, cryptography 1–3
2 Threats, vulnerabilities and attacks 4–8
3 Architecture, data and resilience 9–11
4 Operations: controls, monitoring, identity, automation, response 12–17
5 Governance, risk, compliance, audits, awareness 18–20
6 Final review and practice 21

Spaced review: after each module answer its recall questions from memory, then check. Repeat each Quick Reference Card the next day and again after a week. Also learn the acronym list in the objectives: the exam uses many of them.

7Exam Q&A

7.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors wants to know which domain carries the largest weight in Security+ V8. Which one is it?

  • AGeneral Security Concepts
  • BSecurity Architecture
  • CSecurity Program Management and Oversight
  • DSecurity Operations
Show the answer

Answer: D. Security Operations is 27%, the largest. General Security Concepts is 16%, Architecture 19% and Program Management 14%.

S2A candidate scores 750 on the exam. What does that mean?

  • AThe candidate answered 75% of the questions correctly
  • BThe candidate failed by 50 points
  • CThe candidate must retest with the V7 exam
  • DThe candidate reached the passing score on a scale of 100 to 900
Show the answer

Answer: D. 750 on a scale of 100 to 900 is the passing score. It is not a percentage.

S3During the exam a simulation that asks you to drag steps into order looks long. What is the best approach?

  • ASpend half the exam time on it
  • BLeave it blank because it earns nothing
  • CFlag it, answer the quick questions first and return with the time left
  • DAnswer every other question randomly
Show the answer

Answer: C. Performance-based questions take longer, so flag them, bank the quick points and return.

S4A question asks which action should be taken FIRST during an incident. What does the word FIRST tell you?

  • AChoose the most expensive option
  • BChoose the earliest appropriate step in the process
  • CChoose the most technical option
  • DChoose every step listed
Show the answer

Answer: B. FIRST asks for the earliest step in the sequence, such as containing or verifying.

7.2 Recall questions

R1What is the passing score and scale?

Show the answer

750 on a scale of 100 to 900.

R2How many questions and how many minutes?

Show the answer

A maximum of 90 questions in 90 minutes.

R3Which domain is the largest?

Show the answer

Security Operations (27%).

R4What are the two main question types?

Show the answer

Multiple choice and performance-based.

R5Which part of a question do you read first?

Show the answer

The last sentence.

R6What does V8 add compared with earlier versions?

Show the answer

More coverage of AI-related risks, security operations and modern environments.

8Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Format up to 90 questions (multiple choice and performance-based), 90 minutes, pass at 750 of 900
Domains concepts 16%, threats 24%, architecture 19%, operations 27%, program management 14%
PBQs simulations; flag, answer quick questions first, return; never leave empty
Method last sentence, key facts, remove options, compare with BEST/FIRST/MOST, mark and move on
V8 focus AI risks, security operations, modern environments
